# Menu CSS Names (menu_css_names) — agent index

Adds a per-item CSS class to rendered menu links so each item can be targeted separately in CSS
(also useful for CSS-sprite techniques). It is a pure theming/preprocess module: it implements
`hook_preprocess_menu()`, `hook_preprocess_menu_local_task()` and
`hook_preprocess_menu_local_action()` and, for every menu item, derives a class from the item's link
**title** and appends it to that item's `attributes.class`. The class is generated by the helper
`menu_css_names__make_class_name()`: the title is transliterated to ASCII, `strip_tags`'d, lowercased,
every character that is not `[A-Za-z0-9_-]` is replaced with a hyphen, and leading/trailing and
doubled hyphens are collapsed — so a title `"Product Information"` yields the class `product-information`.

Plain menus are processed unconditionally once the module is enabled (`hook_preprocess_menu` recurses
into the `below` subtree). Local **tasks** (tabs) and local **actions** (action buttons) are only
processed when the matching boolean config toggle is on — both default to `TRUE`. There is a small
admin settings form (two checkboxes) at `/admin/config/menu_css_names`.

- Depends on: `drupal:menu_ui`.
- Core: `^10 || ^11`. Package: none declared in info.yml. Version documented: **2.1.0**.
- Settings page / `configure` route: **yes** — `menu_css_names.settings_form`
  (`/admin/config/menu_css_names`), behind permission `administer menu_css_names configuration`.
- Provides config schema: **yes** (`menu_css_names.settings`). Permissions: **1**. Drush: none.
  Plugin types: none. Services: none. Routes: only the settings form. No fields/widgets/formatters,
  no libraries, no JS/CSS assets, no templates of its own.

## What you'd do → where

- **Turn the local-tasks / local-actions class output on or off; know the config keys & permission** →
  [configure/settings.md](configure/settings.md)
- **Understand exactly how a menu title becomes a class (to predict the class in your CSS, or to
  override/alter the behavior)** → [hooks/preprocess.md](hooks/preprocess.md)

## Key facts (real machine names)

- Hooks implemented (in `menu_css_names.module`): `hook_preprocess_menu`,
  `hook_preprocess_menu_local_task`, `hook_preprocess_menu_local_action`, `hook_help`
  (`help.page.menu_css_names`).
- Helper functions: `menu_css_names__make_class_name($text)` (title → class string),
  `menu_css_names__build_menu_classes(array &$items)` (recurses the menu tree, sets
  `$item['attributes']['class']`).
- Route: `menu_css_names.settings_form` → path `/admin/config/menu_css_names`, form
  `Drupal\menu_css_names\Form\MenuCssNamesSettingsForm` (`getFormId()` = `menu_css_names_settings`).
- Permission: `administer menu_css_names configuration`.
- Config object: `menu_css_names.settings` with keys `local_actions` (boolean, default `TRUE`) and
  `tasks` (boolean, default `TRUE`). Schema type `config_object` in
  `config/schema/menu_css_names.schema.yml`.
- Menu link: `menu_css_names.settings` under `system.admin_config_system`.
- Update hook: `menu_css_names_update_10001()` re-imports the shipped `config/install` settings.
